description: Generates project-aware pre-build specs using project knowledge and codebase context. Phase 1 runs a 7-section spec: outcome contract, states, data contract, failure taxonomy, platform constraints, adversarial questions, unknown unknowns. Phase 2 generates actionable artifacts: build prompt, state scaffold, type definitions, error handling scaffold, pre-ship checklist, test scenarios, task list — referencing real file paths and patterns, not generic best practices. Use when: pre-build spec, spec this out, spec my build, run a spec pass, spec before I code, generate a build spec, what will break, surface the gaps, what am I missing before I build, pre-mortem this build, what could go wrong, unknown unknowns for this feature, adversarial review of my build plan, think through this build, help me plan this feature, build prompt for this, state scaffold, error scaffold, type definitions, pre-ship checklist, test scenarios, task list for this build, I'm about to build, before I start coding.
